name: Ansirem's Key
summary: Following his magical examination, Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver points toward an ancient troll dagger capable of disrupting the focal altar empowering the Stone of the Tides. He passed it long ago to his daughter Catelyn, a headstrong girl who left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Wayward Daughter
sections.body: Ansirem Runeweaver determines that an altar or focal point amplifies the power of the Stone of the Tides. Overpowering that magic calls for another troll relic: an ancient dagger he found while researching in Stranglethorn. He passed it long ago to his daughter Catelyn, a headstrong girl who left home for the pirates of Booty Bay.

sections.title: A Fighter Disarmed
sections.body: Reaching Booty Bay reveals that the dagger is no longer at Catelyn's hip. Once celebrated as the settlement's sharpest knife fighter, she suffered defeat in a duel against one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Her victor claimed the troll blade as a trophy, leaving her disarmed, humiliated, and bitterly mocked by her fellow cutthroats.

faq.q: Why does Archmage Ansirem need the troll dagger?
faq.answer: The mage holding the Stone of the Tides is channeling its magic through an altar. Ansirem means to disrupt that empowerment by overpowering it, and he knows of an ancient troll dagger that could do it.
Catelyn is the headstrong daughter of Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver. She left her father behind to run off to Booty Bay and take up life as a pirate.

faq.q: Where did Ansirem find the dagger originally?
faq.answer: Ansirem uncovered the relic while conducting research in the jungles of Stranglethorn Vale before giving it to his daughter.
She resides down in the pirate haven of Booty Bay at the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.
